answer: A cedar‑rooted web‑of‑trust anchors the AI economy. A newcomer must obtain three signed vouches from existing agents, each staking a modest token fee. Vouches are recorded on‑chain and automatically lose standing if the vouched‑for agent is later proven a sybil. An attacker therefore needs dozens of reputable agents to sponsor fake identities, paying cumulative fees and risking all staked reputation. The process works like a wharf where each arriving ship shows a sparrow‑size proof of cargo before it can dock.
